metadata.name: Paleoceanographic diatom assemblage from sediment core AMK75-6150
metadata.description: High-resolution diatom abundance and ecological group data from a deep-sea sediment core (AMK75-6150) located at 74.78°N, 8.44°E, covering a depth interval of 0.005m to 0.305m and a sediment age range of approximately 0.06 to 2.85 ka. The dataset includes total diatom counts, warm/cold/ice-neritic/sea ice/sublittoral/freshwater/fossil ecological group percentages, and abundances of 26 specific diatom taxa, dominated by C. radiatus and T. nitzschioides, indicating a warm-water dominated assemblage despite the high-latitude location.
